1.title: Trump meets US-backed Venezuelan president for first time since Maduro seized
1.summary: Rodriguez was handpicked by Trump as leader of Venezuela was arrested and taken to the US

2.title: How Scientists Contained a Threat That Could Have Destroyed Humanity
2.summary: A half-century ago, scientists and lawyers agreed to strict self-regulation in DNA research to avoid catastrophe. But it took enforcement to really stop them.

3.title: The Big Beautiful Bill Is Starting to Bite Before the Election
3.summary: The tax cuts in President Trump’s signature achievement were the Republicans’ answer to voters’ economic struggles, but its health care and food assistance cuts are taking a toll.

4.title: U.N. Live Updates: Iran’s President to Address World Leaders After Trump Threat
4.summary: Masoud Pezeshkian is the first leader whose country is at war with the United States to travel to New York to address the General Assembly. President Trump said he faced a choice over whether to “annihilate” the Islamic republic.

5.title: The Winner of This Rivalry Gets Ice Cream. But So Does the Loser.
5.summary: The competition between two popular ice cream shops in Ramallah inspires fierce loyalties, and a running joke, for lovers of cones piled high with flavors.

6.title: Youth Frustration and Migration Shadow Morocco’s Election
6.summary: Unemployment and poor public services fueled the border crisis at Ceuta and Gen Z protests, but frustrated young people may stay away from the polls.
